summary: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. VI reported consummation of its $230M IPO on September 24, 2026, selling 23,000,000 units at $10.00 each, including full exercise of the 3,000,000-unit over-allotment option. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one-half warrant exercisable at $11.50. Simultaneously, sponsor Live Oak Sponsor VI, LLC purchased 4,600,000 private placement warrants at $1.00, raising $4.6M. Total proceeds of $230M were deposited into a Continental Stock Transfer trust account; an audited September 24, 2026 balance sheet is attached. What to watch: trust yield, redemption mechanics, and the initial business combination clock.
